name: F&M Co.,Ltd.
summary: F&M Co., Ltd. provides management and accounting support to small and medium-sized enterprises and individual business owners through Accounting Services, Consulting, Business Solutions and Real Estate Leasing segments. Its consulting covers financial analysis, risk mitigation and human resource development. Dating from 1990 as The Flower Co., it adopted its present name in December 1993 and has its head office in Osaka, Japan.
